steps.code:
# Add the remaining songs to the playlist
# Parse each line: "Title by Artist" or "Title by Artist1, Artist2"
for line in song_lines[1:]:
    # Split on " by " to get title and artists part
    parts = line.split(" by ")
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Skipping malformed line: {line}")
        continue
    title = parts[0].strip()
    # Search for the song by title
    search = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_token)
    if not search:
        print(f"No search results for: {title}")
        continue
    # Use the first result's song_id
    song_id = search[0]['song_id']
    add = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=song_id, access_token=spotify_token)
    print(f"Added: {title} -> {add}")
